surfaces.storage: Local Application Support storage is marked and read-back verified for OS-managed backup exclusion. A bounded, non-authoritative Today Care projection is shared with the Widget extension through the production App Group; the container is marked and verified before private writes and each final snapshot is marked and verified after atomic replacement. Restricted automatic backup uses the user's iCloud Drive container.
surfaces.userControl: Settings privacy/account flows, restricted recovery backup export/import, and delete-my-data reset. The restricted package is not a complete GDPR/CCPA access or portability export.
surfaces.manifestEvidence: Ohana/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy must match actual required-reason API usage and collected data posture.
deletionPaths: AppResetService delete-my-data flow pauses and generation-fences Widget refreshes, then sanitizes or removes the projection before persistent deletion; failed persistent deletion releases the fence and schedules projection recovery
exportPaths: DataBackupManager.exportJSON restricted recovery package; complete access/portability export remains a separate release requirement

surfaces.storage: SwiftData local store; PIN secrets must not be exported in backups.
surfaces.userControl: Field-level privacy controls and local member PIN flows where currently reachable; same-device identity is attribution, not a developer account or security vault.
surfaces.manifestEvidence: Backups reject PIN hash/salt fields and UI surfaces must use privacy placeholders.
